logic_ref.description: Where the rule's implementation lives (a module path or function name).

monetization_ref.description: Which platform/casegen valuation function computes this rule's value_usd band.

answer_key_ids.description: PoC grading only: which answer-key items this rule is expected to satisfy. Optional, because a real engagement has no answer key, and a rule catalog that cannot be written without one is a catalog that only works against Condor. Every rule in THIS repository must still carry it - P4-07 asserts that, not the schema.
